anchor.semantic_hook: Having part of the blame is staged by making each share of blame a separate segment of a divided courtroom gavel.

anchor.absurd_element: an immense courtroom gavel divided into six person-sized segments

variations.scene_adjust: two pushed-back chairs, two untouched cups, and a closed discussion folder
